header.imgAlt: Person contemplating the city from the edge of a lake with open arms, in a serene light blue atmosphere.
header.paragraph: An agency is more than a pretty name. Netneo was born from a personal vision: to create unique digital solutions, without copying, without shortcuts, and with genuine human connection.

philosophy.title3: This is what we <blue>believe</blue> in. And how we <pink>work</pink>
philosophy.paragraph: We don't do mass projects. We don't sell empty solutions. We believe in the power of digital when it's done with intention, with respect for the brand, and with a clear vision. This is our way of working. This is Netneo.

philosophyList.title: Respect above all
philosophyList.imgAlt: Image of number 1 in light green color
philosophyList.paragraph: We're tired of seeing how many clients are used, rushed, overcharged, and abandoned. Cloned websites. Mass-produced services that don't represent their product or their story.

philosophyList.title: That's why Netneo exists
philosophyList.imgAlt: Image of number 2 in light red color
philosophyList.paragraph: Netneo was born to be the opposite. Our way of working has character, intention, and above all: respect for those who trust us. Every project reflects the person or brand behind it.

philosophyList.title: No copy and paste
philosophyList.imgAlt: Image of number 3 in light purple color
philosophyList.paragraph: We don't use recycled templates or empty formulas. What we create has meaning, structure, and purpose. It's design with soul and development with sense.

philosophyList.title: What we're worth, it's worth
philosophyList.imgAlt: Image of number 4 in light orange color
philosophyList.paragraph: Our prices reflect the real value of the service, not a random number. We don't give our work away, because what we do isn't something you find everywhere.

philosophyList.title: We don't disappear. We stay involved
philosophyList.imgAlt: Image of number 5 in light green color
philosophyList.paragraph: We don't deliver and vanish. We stay. We take care of your project after launch, because we know that what's built well also deserves to be maintained well.
